Syntal Capital Partners LLC Lowers Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Caroline Horne | Jan 29th, 2018 
Syntal Capital Partners LLC reduced its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 15.9% during the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 7,380 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,400 shares during the period. Apple accounts for approximately 0.8% of Syntal Capital Partners LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 11th largest holding. Syntal Capital Partners LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,137,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
A number of other institutional investors have also recently made changes to their positions in the stock. Middleton & Co Inc MA increased its position in shares of Apple by 21.0% during the third quarter. Middleton & Co Inc MA now owns 128,013 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $19,729,000 after buying an additional 22,207 shares during the period. Concorde Asset Management LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 64.4% during the third quarter. Concorde Asset Management LLC now owns 6,862 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,058,000 after buying an additional 2,689 shares during the period. Savant Capital LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 1.7% during the third quarter. Savant Capital LLC now owns 43,369 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,684,000 after buying an additional 717 shares during the period. Villere ST Denis J & Co. LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 0.7% during the third quarter. Villere ST Denis J & Co. LLC now owns 60,538 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,330,000 after buying an additional 405 shares during the period. Finally, Palisade Capital Management LLC NJ increased its position in shares of Apple by 3.7% during the third quarter. Palisade Capital Management LLC NJ now owns 168,419 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,957,000 after buying an additional 6,069 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 60.26% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
AAPL has been the topic of several analyst reports. Drexel Hamilton reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $208.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 9th. UBS Group reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 9th. Vetr cut shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $173.47 price objective on the stock. in a research report on Friday, October 6th. Robert W. Baird restated a “buy” rating and issued a $175.00 price objective (up from $172.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 4th. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies restated a “buy” rating and issued a $196.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 11th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have issued a hold rating, thirty-six have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $200.70. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 14th. The stock was sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total transaction of $2,695,726.35. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 39,682 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $6,839,192.70. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, November 30th. The shares were sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total value of $11,215,947.60. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock valued at $22,115,155. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $171.51 on Monday. The stock has a market capitalization of $872,480.88, a P/E ratio of 18.64, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.39 and a beta of 1.21. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $120.62 and a 52 week high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $1.87 by $0.20. The firm had revenue of $52.58 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $50.71 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm posted $1.50 earnings per share. equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.17 EPS for the current year. Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
